label: Write/update BDD scenarios
guidance: Read the source requirement first (issue + comments, e.g. `gh issue view <N> --json title,body,comments`) and write down explicit, checkable acceptance criteria — these become the conformance checklist verified later. Then write/update feature files to behaviour-led best practice. DECLARATIVE, not imperative: describe the observable outcome from the user's perspective in ubiquitous domain language — never implementation detail, UI mechanics, selectors, or incidental wiring. Express INTENT; never fabricate implementation details that are not yet designed — use concrete values only where they are real and verified. Strict Given-When-Then: Given = context/preconditions (no actions, no assertions), When = the single triggering action (one logical When), Then = observable outcomes only; one behaviour per scenario; no conjunctive `And` steps smuggling extra actions or assertions. Titles state the behaviour rule, never "test X works". REUSE phrasing: grep the existing feature files and match established step wording before inventing new phrasing — consistent wording is what makes steps reusable. Background only for genuinely shared context; Scenario Outline only for true data variations. Coverage: every acceptance criterion maps to a scenario; every acceptance criterion maps to at least one scenario — happy path, error/edge cases, authorization variations, and both sides of every boundary/limit; document any deliberate exclusion instead of silently dropping it. Done when scenarios are updated and the acceptance criteria are written down.
